text.Imperial Palace:
How to Play ==
At any time during your turn, draw a card and choose an opponent who must immediately discard a card. If you have another Star Empire card in play, gain 4 Combat. Imperial Palace is an outpost with a defense of 6. 
 Strategy Edit ==
Drawing a card and making an opponent discard a card are both very good, and with a defense of 6 there is a good chance it may last another turn. This is especially true if you can make your opponent discard even more cards. The ally ability is solid too. Since this card is a free play anyways (due to the draw ability) it is definitely a good card to buy at any time.
